procedure.title: 機能テスト手順(共通設定なし・全ステップ個別定義スタイル)

steps.title: ad-hoc: 行内指定で全6ホストの疎通確認
steps.command: ansible -e '{"CHECK_LABEL": "機能テスト", "HOGE": "FUGA"}' all -i samples/local_test/inventory.ini -m shell -a 'echo "{{CHECK_LABEL}}: host={{ inventory_hostname }}"'
steps.criteria:
rc == 0 and
out("機能テスト: host=web01") and out("機能テスト: host=web02") and
out("機能テスト: host=web03") and out("機能テスト: host=db01") and
out("機能テスト: host=db02") and out("機能テスト: host=mon01") and
not out("UNREACHABLE|FAILED")

steps.title: ad-hoc: RB-LOCALDEF で定義するスタイル
steps.command: ansible web -i samples/local_test/inventory_web.ini -e '{"CHECK_LABEL": "機能テスト", "HOGE": "FUGA"}' -m shell -a uptime
steps.criteria:
rc == 0 and out("web01") and out("web02") and out("web03") and
not out("db01|db02|mon01") and not out("UNREACHABLE|FAILED")

steps.title: playbook: 行内 -i と -e(実行時上書き)
steps.command: ansible-playbook -e '{"CHECK_LABEL": "機能テスト", "HOGE": "FUGA"}' -i samples/local_test/inventory_web.ini samples/local_test/show_var.yml -e HOGE=PIYO
steps.criteria:
rc == 0 and out("HOGE=PIYO") and not out("HOGE=FUGA") and
not out("failed=[1-9]|unreachable=[1-9]")

steps.title: playbook: 行ごとのインベントリ切替
steps.command: ansible-playbook -e '{"CHECK_LABEL": "機能テスト", "HOGE": "FUGA"}' -i samples/local_test/inventory_web.ini samples/local_test/show_var.yml && ansible-playbook -e '{"CHECK_LABEL": "機能テスト", "HOGE": "FUGA"}' -i samples/local_test/inventory_db.ini samples/local_test/show_var.yml -e HOGE=DB_RUN
steps.criteria:
rc == 0 and
out("HOGE=FUGA \(host=web01\)") and out("HOGE=FUGA \(host=web03\)") and
out("HOGE=DB_RUN \(host=db01\)") and out("HOGE=DB_RUN \(host=db02\)") and
not out("failed=[1-9]|unreachable=[1-9]")

steps.title: ad-hoc: 行内指定 + 行内 -e の優先確認
steps.command: ansible -e '{"CHECK_LABEL": "機能テスト", "HOGE": "FUGA"}' db -i samples/local_test/inventory_db.ini -e HOGE=ADHOC -m shell -a 'echo "HOGE={{ HOGE }} on {{ inventory_hostname }}"'
steps.criteria:
rc == 0 and
out("HOGE=ADHOC on db01") and out("HOGE=ADHOC on db02") and
not out("HOGE=FUGA") and not out("web01|web02|web03|mon01") and
not out("UNREACHABLE|FAILED")

steps.title: bash: ローカルステップとの混在確認
steps.criteria: rc == 0 and "local step on" in stdout and out("Linux")
